The target is a definition, so the binders are `(colorCount : ℕ) (coloring : ℂ → Fin colorCount)`, and the original side is `ProperColoring colorCount coloring`.

A clearer restatement: any two points at distance 1 get different colors. Using `dist` is more standard than the norm of a difference: `dist point otherPoint = 1`, and `Complex.dist_eq` states `dist z w = ‖z - w‖`.

The proof unfolds the definition, then `simp only [Complex.dist_eq]` rewrites `dist` into the norm.

Restated: `∀ p q : ℂ, dist p q = 1 → coloring p ≠ coloring q`.

Proof: `unfold ProperColoring; simp only [Complex.dist_eq]`. After the simp, both sides should be syntactically identical and `simp only` closes the goal with `Iff.rfl`. The namespace is OAI.EuclideanFiveColor, so `ProperColoring` resolves when unfolded. I'll use `unfold ProperColoring` followed by `simp only [Complex.dist_eq]`.
